sentences.en: Father has now got a superior position in his office.
sentences.zh: 父亲现在在公司里有了更重要的职位。

sentences.en: I will judge whether it is superior or not.
sentences.zh: 我将判断这是否更优越。

sentences.en: You must be superior to me in this skill.
sentences.zh: 你在这种技能上一定比我强。

senses.zh: 更好的，优越的；上级的，高级的
上级，长官；上标；修道院院长；上师
